import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im15 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0015.png'))

print('Leg right bottom v:', leg_right[:,0].max(), 'u:', leg_right[leg_right[:,0] == leg_right[:,0].max(), 1].mean())
